metadata.description: Quality engineering plugin marketplace for modern software teams: data quality, visual regression, contract testing, flake triage, bug reproduction, manual testing, BDD, property-based, chaos, shift-left, shift-right, security testing (SAST/DAST/SCA/SBOM/secrets/compliance), LLM evaluation, ML model testing, distributed tracing, real-time protocols, PDF/print, search relevance, concurrency, saga/CQRS, charts, resilience drills, and more. Every component is rating-gated before merge.

plugins.name: qa-data-quality
plugins.description: Data quality testing for analytical pipelines: 5 skills (dbt-testing, great-expectations, soda-checks, data-quality-gate, data-quality-conventions) and 2 agents (schema-diff-reviewer, data-anomaly-triager).

plugins.name: qa-visual-regression
plugins.description: Visual regression testing: 7 skills (percy-visual-regression-testing, chromatic-visual-regression-testing, playwright-snapshots, storybook-visual-regression-testing, responsive-breakpoint-runner, visual-baseline-conventions, visual-baseline-gate) and 2 agents (visual-diff-classifier, visual-baseline-curator).

plugins.name: qa-contract-testing
plugins.description: Contract testing for microservices: 5 skills (pact-contract-testing, openapi-contract-diff, graphql-schema-regression, protobuf-compat-checking, contract-compatibility-gate) and 1 agent (contract-drift-investigator).

plugins.name: qa-flake-triage
plugins.description: Flake triage: 2 skills (flaky-test-quarantine, flake-pattern-reference) and 5 agents (e2e-flake-bisector, parallel-isolation-checker, regression-bisector, ai-flake-detector, e2e-test-trend-reporter).

plugins.name: qa-bug-repro
plugins.description: Bug reproduction workflow: 1 skill (bug-report-template) and 4 agents (bug-repro-builder, crash-stack-trace-analyzer, defect-clusterer, escape-defect-analyzer).

plugins.name: qa-shift-left
plugins.description: Shift-left QA: 3 skills (acceptance-criteria-extractor, nfr-extractor, data-contract-extractor) and 4 agents (testability-reviewer, definition-of-done-checker, threat-model-from-spec, spec-to-suite-orchestrator).

plugins.name: qa-api-testing
plugins.description: API testing: 7 skills (postman-collections, restassured-testing, karate-testing, tavern-testing, schemathesis-fuzzing, restler-fuzzing, api-chaos-runner).

plugins.name: qa-load-testing
plugins.description: Load and performance testing: 9 skills (k6-load-testing, jmeter-load-testing, gatling-load-testing, locust-load-testing, lighthouse-perf, perf-budget-gate, lighthouse-budget-author, flame-graph-analyzer, db-slow-query-detector) and 1 agent (perf-regression-bisector).

plugins.name: qa-test-data
plugins.description: Test data engineering: 16 skills (faker-data, factory-bot-data, mimesis-data, bogus-data, wiremock-stubs, msw-handlers, mountebank-imposters, synthetic-data-toolkit, golden-file-conventions, seed-data-curator, parameterized-test-generator, boundary-value-generator, e2e-test-narrative-builder, synthetic-pii-generator, malicious-payload-bank, negative-test-generator) and 1 agent (golden-file-manager).

plugins.name: qa-accessibility-specifics
plugins.description: Atomic accessibility coverage: 12 skills (wcag-keyboard-navigation, wcag-focus-trap, wcag-color-contrast, aria-authoring-patterns, screen-reader-test-author, a11y-violation-gate, wcag-checklist-builder, axe-a11y, pa11y-a11y, lighthouse-a11y, wave-a11y, ibm-equal-access-a11y) and 1 agent (accessibility-code-critic).

plugins.name: qa-test-environment
plugins.description: Test environment management: 4 skills (testcontainers, docker-compose-test, feature-flag-test-harness, playwright-fixture-builder) and 1 agent (db-snapshot-restore). Composes with parallel-isolation-checker in qa-flake-triage for shared-state diagnosis.

plugins.name: qa-test-reporting
plugins.description: Test reporting + coverage analytics: 16 skills — parsers (junit-xml-analysis, lcov-analysis, cobertura-analysis, allure-reports), build-an-X reporters (coverage-diff-reporter, wcag-compliance-reporter, visual-diff-summarizer), commercial integrations (extentreports, currents-integration, testrail-integration, xray-integration, zephyr-integration), per-language coverage analyzers (jest-coverage-analysis, jacoco-analysis, coverage-py-analysis), and unit-test-coverage-targeter.

plugins.name: qa-test-impact-analysis
plugins.description: Test impact analysis + regression-suite hygiene: 2 skills (regression-suite-selector, coverage-debt-tracker) and 2 agents (test-suite-pruner, regression-suite-curator).

plugins.name: qa-roles
plugins.description: QA org chart of 15 sharply-scoped role agents across four tiers. Tier 1 IC: exploratory-charter-author, automation-harness-bootstrapper, load-test-plan-designer, security-test-plan-builder, a11y-manual-test-scripter, data-quality-engineer, production-tester. Tier 2 Lead: test-architect, test-effort-estimator, quality-coach, test-quality-coach. Tier 3 Manager: release-engineer, release-cutover-coordinator, qa-manager. Tier 4 Head/Director: head-of-quality. No generic persona-as-scope agents.

plugins.name: qa-test-review
plugins.description: Test code reviewers for test files only — production code is out of scope. 1 skill (test-code-conventions) and 4 adversarial agents (test-code-critic, assertion-quality-reviewer, mocking-anti-pattern-detector, e2e-selector-quality-critic).

plugins.name: qa-manual-testing
plugins.description: Manual scripted + exploratory testing: 11 skills (manual-test-script-author, test-execution-checklist, exploratory-tours-reference, bug-bash-facilitator, uat-script-author, manual-test-debrief, sbtm-reference, hiccupps-f-heuristic, sfdpot-heuristic, fcc-cuts-vids-heuristic, crusspic-stmpl-heuristic). Covers SBTM, Whittaker's seven tours, Bach + Bolton's heuristic catalogues (HICCUPPS-F oracles, SFDPOT variation, FCC CUTS VIDS modelling, CRUSSPIC STMPL quality criteria), UAT, bug bashes, and PROOF debriefs.

plugins.name: qa-property-based
plugins.description: Property-based testing libraries: 5 skills covering Hypothesis (Python), fast-check (JS/TS), proptest (Rust), jqwik (JVM), and QuickCheck (Haskell) + ScalaCheck. Each ships authoring + run + shrinking + CI integration.

plugins.name: qa-shift-right
plugins.description: Production-side QA per ISTQB-canonical shift right ("a test approach to test a system continuously in production"): 3 skills (synthetic-monitor-author, prod-canary-validator, feature-flag-experiment-validator) and 1 agent (observability-to-test).

plugins.name: qa-mobile-native
plugins.description: Mobile + mobile-web E2E testing: 10 skills covering xcuitest-suite, espresso-suite, appium-testing, detox-testing, maestro-flows, flutter-testing, mobile-device-matrix-toolkit, mobile-web-emulation-runner, touch-gesture-tester, mobile-perf-budget.

plugins.name: qa-mutation-testing
plugins.description: Mutation testing across languages: 5 skills (stryker-mutation, stryker-net-mutation, pitest-mutation, mutmut-mutation, mull-mutation) and 1 agent (mutation-survivor-explainer).

plugins.name: qa-process
plugins.description: Test process + methodology: 19 skills + 6 agents covering risk-based testing, DoD, test strategy, blameless post-mortems, release readiness, smoke gating, pyramid analysis, TDD coaching, E2E budgets.

plugins.name: qa-chaos-resilience
plugins.description: Chaos engineering + fault injection: 6 skills (chaos-experiment-author, litmus-chaos, chaos-mesh, gremlin-chaos, toxiproxy-chaos, failure-injection-test-author).

plugins.name: qa-bdd
plugins.description: BDD pipelines: 7 skills (cucumber-testing, behave-testing, reqnroll-testing, specflow-testing legacy, bdd-step-library-curator, gherkin-from-stories, acceptance-test-from-criteria) and 1 agent (gherkin-style-reviewer).

plugins.name: qa-localization
plugins.description: Localization (l10n) + i18n testing: 4 skills (i18n-string-coverage, pseudo-localization-runner, rtl-rendering-tester, locale-format-validator).

plugins.name: qa-ai-assisted
plugins.description: AI-assisted test generation + curation: 3 skills (ai-test-generator, ai-spec-coverage-mapper, model-based-test-graph-author) and 1 agent (ai-test-curator).

plugins.name: qa-compatibility
plugins.description: Browser + OS compatibility testing: 3 skills (browser-matrix-runner, os-matrix-runner, compatibility-budget).

plugins.name: qa-web-e2e
plugins.description: Web E2E framework wrappers: 6 skills (playwright-testing, cypress-testing, selenium-testing, webdriverio-testing, puppeteer-testing, testcafe-testing) and 2 agents (playwright-codegen-reviewer, selenium-grid-orchestrator).

plugins.name: qa-ci-integration
plugins.description: CI/CD test workflow patterns: 5 skills (github-actions-test-jobs, gitlab-ci-test-jobs, jenkinsfile-test-stages, circleci-test-configs, ci-test-job-conventions).

plugins.name: qa-iac
plugins.description: Infrastructure-as-code testing + security policy: 5 skills (helm-chart-tester, policy-as-code-runner, checkov-policy, tfsec-policy, kics-policy) and 2 agents (terraform-plan-reviewer, iac-policy-checker).

plugins.name: qa-cli-tools
plugins.description: CLI + TUI testing tools: 3 skills (bats-testing, tui-snapshot-tester, cli-output-conventions).

plugins.name: qa-llm-evaluation
plugins.description: LLM and prompt evaluation: 6 skills (promptfoo-evaluation, openai-evals, deepeval-evaluation, ragas-evaluation, giskard-llm, langfuse-tracing) and 1 agent (prompt-eval-reviewer). Covers the mainstream OSS LLM-eval ecosystem: Promptfoo + OpenAI Evals + DeepEval + Ragas for functional eval, Giskard for adversarial scan, Langfuse for production observability.

plugins.name: qa-db-migrations
plugins.description: Database migration testing: 4 skills (flyway-migrations, liquibase-migrations, atlas-migrations, sqlmesh-migrations) and 1 agent (migration-blast-radius-reviewer). Covers schema-change safety, blast-radius review, and rollback verification across the major migration tools.

plugins.name: qa-async-jobs
plugins.description: Background job and queue testing: 7 skills (sidekiq-tests, celery-tests, bullmq-tests, sqs-patterns, rabbitmq-patterns, cron-job-test-author, idempotency-test-author). Covers async job runners, queue patterns, scheduled jobs, and idempotency guarantees.

plugins.name: qa-auth-flows
plugins.description: Auth flow testing: 5 skills (keycloak-tests, auth0-tests, okta-tests, oauth-flow-test-author, session-management-test-author). Anchored on OAuth 2.0 / RFC 7636 PKCE / RFC 9700 / OWASP ASVS V3.

plugins.name: qa-notifications
plugins.description: Notifications + messaging testing across email/SMS/push/webhooks: 6 skills (mailpit-testing, mailhog-testing, email-flow-test-author, sms-test-author, push-notification-test-author, webhook-delivery-tester).

plugins.name: qa-sast
plugins.description: SAST (static application security testing): 5 skills (semgrep-rules, sonarqube-rules, codeql-queries, bandit-python, gosec-go) and 1 agent (sast-finding-triager). Every scanner skill includes a mandatory False-positive triage section.

plugins.name: qa-dast
plugins.description: DAST (dynamic application security testing): 4 skills (zap-baseline, burp-headless, nightvision-dast, dast-baseline-runner) and 1 agent (dast-finding-triager). Sister to qa-sast for runtime vulnerabilities. Every scanner skill includes a mandatory False-positive triage section.

plugins.name: qa-sca
plugins.description: SCA (software composition analysis): 5 skills (snyk-test, osv-scanner, dependabot-config, renovate-config, npm-pip-maven-audit) and 1 agent (sca-prioritizer with CVSS + EPSS + CISA KEV + reachability prioritization).

plugins.name: qa-secrets
plugins.description: Secrets scanning + rotation: 4 skills (gitleaks-scanning, trufflehog-scanning, kingfisher-scanning, secrets-rotation-runner). Covers detection AND rotation workflow (git-history scrub doesn't fix the leak).

plugins.name: qa-sbom
plugins.description: SBOM generation + container image scanning + vuln prioritization: 5 skills (syft-generation, grype-scanning, cyclonedx-format, spdx-format, trivy-image) and 1 agent (vuln-prioritizer). Required for US EO 14028 + EU CRA + FDA medical-device guidance.

plugins.name: qa-compliance
plugins.description: Compliance test patterns + readiness review: 6 skills (gdpr-test-patterns, ccpa-test-patterns, soc2-evidence-collector, hipaa-test-patterns, pci-dss-scope-checker, audit-trail-test-author) and 1 agent (compliance-readiness-reviewer). Covers regulated-industry test pattern catalogs.

plugins.name: qa-unit-tests-js
plugins.description: JS/TS unit testing per-framework wrappers: 5 skills (jest-tests, vitest-tests, mocha-tests, ava-tests, jasmine-tests). Per-framework lifecycle (configure / run / mock / coverage / CI). Does not duplicate qa-test-review test code hygiene.

plugins.name: qa-unit-tests-python
plugins.description: Python unit testing per-framework wrappers: 4 skills (pytest-tests, unittest-tests, doctest-tests, nose2-tests).

plugins.name: qa-unit-tests-jvm
plugins.description: JVM unit testing per-framework wrappers: 5 skills (junit5-tests, kotest-tests, spock-tests, testng-tests, scalatest).

plugins.name: qa-unit-tests-net
plugins.description: .NET unit testing per-framework wrappers: 4 skills (xunit-tests, nunit-tests, mstest-tests, fluentassertions).

plugins.name: qa-unit-tests-go-rust
plugins.description: Go + Rust unit testing per-framework wrappers: 4 skills (go-test, ginkgo-tests, cargo-test, rstest-tests).

plugins.name: qa-code-quality
plugins.description: Production code quality: 5 skills (sonarqube-quality-perspective, codeclimate-config, lizard-complexity, madge-deps, knip-dead-code) and 1 agent (code-quality-critic). Production-only scope; test-code hygiene is owned by qa-test-review.

plugins.name: qa-ml-models
plugins.description: ML model testing: 5 skills (giskard-tests, deepchecks-tests, evidently-monitoring, fairlearn-fairness, alibi-explainability) and 1 agent (model-fairness-reviewer). Covers vulnerability scanning, drift monitoring, group fairness, and per-prediction explainability.

plugins.name: qa-modern-web
plugins.description: Modern web testing: 5 skills (service-worker-tests, pwa-install-flow-tests, web-vitals-inp-deep, browser-extension-tests, sw-cache-strategy-author). Covers PWA + Chromium MV3 extensions + INP responsiveness.

plugins.name: qa-data-notebooks
plugins.description: Jupyter notebook testing: 3 skills (nbval-tests, testbook-tests, papermill-tests). Covers full-notebook regression (nbval), function-level unit tests (testbook), and parameterized execution (papermill).

plugins.name: qa-distributed-tracing
plugins.description: Distributed tracing assertion testing: 4 skills (opentelemetry-trace-assertions, jaeger-trace-tests, zipkin-trace-tests, trace-spec-author) and 1 agent (trace-coverage-reviewer). Asserts on production trace shape (spans, attributes, parent links, status), not just on aggregate metrics.

plugins.name: qa-realtime-protocols
plugins.description: Real-time protocol testing: 5 skills (websocket-tests, server-sent-events-tests, grpc-streaming-tests, mqtt-tests, webhook-replay-tests). Anchored on RFC 6455, WHATWG SSE, gRPC streaming, MQTT v5, and the Standard Webhooks signature scheme.

plugins.name: qa-pdf-print-render
plugins.description: PDF + print rendering tests: 4 skills (pdf-snapshot-tester, print-stylesheet-tests, html-to-pdf-regression, pdf-accessibility-checker). Covers print/PDF output where qa-visual-regression covers screen output.

plugins.name: qa-search-relevance
plugins.description: Search relevance testing: 3 skills (elasticsearch-relevance-tests, opensearch-relevance-tests, vector-search-precision-tests) and 1 agent (relevance-regression-reviewer). IR-metrics-driven NDCG / MRR / Recall@k regression detection.

plugins.name: qa-concurrency
plugins.description: Concurrency + race-condition testing: 5 skills (jepsen-patterns, race-condition-test-author, deadlock-detection-harness, async-ordering-tests, mvcc-isolation-tests). Code-level data races, distinct from qa-chaos-resilience (infrastructure fault injection).

plugins.name: qa-saga-cqrs
plugins.description: Saga + CQRS + event sourcing test patterns: 4 skills (saga-transaction-tests, event-sourcing-tests, cqrs-projection-tests, eventual-consistency-tests). Covers ACD-without-isolation saga tests, replay determinism, and projection consistency windows.

plugins.name: qa-charts-dataviz
plugins.description: Chart + data viz testing: 3 skills (chartjs-snapshot-tests, d3-snapshot-tests, vega-spec-validator). Covers Canvas + SVG + declarative-spec visualizations, complementing qa-visual-regression which targets general UI screens.

plugins.name: qa-resilience-drills
plugins.description: Resilience drills: 5 skills (dr-drill-runner, backup-verification-author, restore-time-tests, error-budget-tests, mttr-mtbf-tracker). Production-grade DR drills + backup verification + RTO + error-budget gating + incident metrics.

plugins.name: qa-hiring
plugins.description: QA hiring toolkit: 5 skills (qa-jd-author, interview-question-author, hiring-rubric-author, calibration-guide-author, onboarding-plan-author) and 1 agent (interview-debrief-facilitator) covering the full hiring chain for QA / SDET / test-lead / quality-manager roles - job descriptions, ISTQB-aligned question banks, role-specific scoring rubrics, interviewer calibration per Levashina 2014 et al., post-interview debriefs, and 30-60-90 onboarding plans.

plugins.name: qa-team-management
plugins.description: QA people-and-org toolkit for QA managers and heads of quality: 5 skills (skill-matrix-author, career-ladder-author, tester-one-on-one-planner, performance-feedback-author, exec-quality-narrative) plus the team-capability-gap-analyst agent. Covers team capability mapping per ISTQB CTAL-TM v3.0 Managing the Team, IC/management career ladders, GROW-model 1:1s, SBI evidence-based feedback, and Minto-pyramid executive quality narratives.

plugins.name: qa-test-data-privacy
plugins.description: PII detection, masking, and synthetic data generation for test environments: 5 skills (pii-categories-reference, data-masking-techniques-reference, presidio-pii-detection, faker-synthetic-data, synthea-healthcare-data) + 1 build skill (pii-masking-pipeline-builder) and 1 agent (pii-leak-critic).

plugins.name: qa-defect-management
plugins.description: Defect management discipline (taxonomy, lifecycle, workflows): 3 reference skills (bug-lifecycle-reference, severity-vs-priority-reference, defect-taxonomy-istqb) + 3 platform-workflow skills (jira-bug-workflow-runner, linear-bug-workflow-runner, github-issues-bug-workflow) + 1 build skill (bug-report-from-failure) + 2 agents (duplicate-defect-finder, bug-report-critic). Distinct from qa-bug-repro which covers reproduction + clustering + trend narration; this covers triage workflow + taxonomy + severity classification.

plugins.name: qa-test-management
plugins.description: Test case management discipline (pre-execution authoring + lifecycle + traceability): 1 reference skill (test-case-anatomy-reference) + 5 platform case-management skills (testrail-case-management, xray-case-management, zephyr-scale-case-management, allure-testops-case-management, qase-io-case-management) + 1 build skill (traceability-matrix-builder) + 1 agent (test-case-quality-critic). Distinct from qa-test-reporting's *-integration skills (post-execution result sync); this is pre-execution case authoring + repository management.

plugins.name: qa-fuzz-testing
plugins.description: Structure-aware coverage-guided fuzzing: 2 reference skills (corpus-management-reference, sanitiser-integration-reference) + 7 per-language fuzzer skills (libfuzzer-cpp, afl-plus-plus, go-native-fuzzing, cargo-fuzz-rust, atheris-python-fuzzing, jazzer-jvm-fuzzing, ossfuzz-integration) + 1 dispatcher skill (fuzz-toolkit-dispatcher) + 1 agent (fuzz-target-author). Distinct from qa-property-based (hypothesis-driven + shrinking) and qa-api-testing/schemathesis-fuzzing (API-layer); this is binary/system-level coverage-guided fuzzing.

plugins.name: qa-multi-tenancy
plugins.description: Tenant-isolation testing for B2B SaaS: row-level security, cross-tenant leak detection, tenant-id propagation tracing, isolation-model references (silo / pool / bridge), and adversarial review of tenant-leak risk.

plugins.name: qa-grpc
plugins.description: gRPC testing tooling: buf-CLI lint and breaking-build, ghz load testing, grpcurl CLI, grpc-mock servers, protobuf versioning strategy reference, gRPC streaming test patterns, and status-code mapping reference. Distinct from qa-realtime-protocols/grpc-streaming-tests (wire-level streaming semantics) and qa-contract-testing/protobuf-compat-checking (schema-level breaking detection); this plugin scopes to tooling, load, linting, and framework-level testing.

plugins.name: qa-graphql
plugins.description: GraphQL server testing: introspection attack-surface reference, persisted-query strategy, per-framework testing (Apollo Server, GraphQL Yoga, Hasura, Mercurius, Pothos), and an N+1 query detector. Distinct from qa-contract-testing/graphql-schema-regression (contract drift detection); this plugin covers server/runtime + framework-specific patterns.

plugins.name: qa-cache-testing
plugins.description: Cache testing across layers: Redis cache patterns, CDN cache-purge testing (Cloudflare, Fastly, CloudFront), Varnish VTC syntax, browser Cache-Control tests, cache-coherence + stampede + stale-while-revalidate references, and a cache-key collision detector. Covers RFC 9111 HTTP caching and the canonical multi-tier cache discipline (browser to CDN to app to data store).

plugins.name: qa-experimentation
plugins.description: Experimentation harness testing: SDK-specific testing for Statsig, Optimizely, VWO, Amplitude Experiment; sample-ratio-mismatch (SRM) detection; AB-test validity checklist; guardrail-metrics + peeking-problem references. Distinct from qa-shift-right/feature-flag-experiment-validator (validates experiment results); this plugin tests the experimentation harness itself (SDK behaviour, assignment integrity, statistical-validity gates).

plugins.name: qa-feature-flags
plugins.description: Feature-flag platform testing: SDK-specific tests for LaunchDarkly, Unleash, Flagsmith, GrowthBook; feature-flag test matrix reference; flag-state coverage builder; flag-removal runbook author; stale-flag detector. Distinct from qa-test-environment/feature-flag-test-harness (generic flag-aware test harness) and qa-shift-right/feature-flag-experiment-validator (validates experiment results); this plugin scopes to platform-SDK testing + flag-lifecycle hygiene.

plugins.name: qa-serverless
plugins.description: Serverless platform testing: AWS SAM Local, .NET Lambda Test Tools, Cloudflare Workers Miniflare, Vercel Edge Runtime, Netlify Functions, Serverless Framework, plus cold-start + timeout budget references and a serverless integration-test builder. Covers Lambda / Workers / Edge runtimes which have specific testing patterns (cold-start budgets, timeout testing, local emulators, edge-runtime divergence) absent from generic web-server test plugins.

plugins.name: qa-time-and-timezones
plugins.description: Time-related testing: fake-clock libraries (libfaketime, sinon-fake-timers, jest-fake-timers, freezegun, timecop, mockclock), DST + leap-second references, ISO-8601 vs RFC 3339 reference, and a timezone test matrix builder. Covers time-based bugs (DST transitions, leap seconds, timezone arithmetic, clock skew) which are high-incident-rate but specific tooling is scattered.

plugins.name: qa-payment
plugins.description: Payment platform sandbox testing: Stripe test cards + webhooks, Adyen test mode, PayPal sandbox, Braintree test cards; 3DS test flow + PCI DSS scope + payment flow states references; refund + chargeback + webhook-replay builders. Distinct from qa-compliance/pci-dss-scope-checker (compliance / scope verification); this plugin is platform-specific sandbox testing + payment flow state matrices.

plugins.name: qa-browser-extension
plugins.description: Firefox + Chrome extension lifecycle, MV2 to MV3 migration, host-permission prompts, and storage.sync vs storage.local test patterns

plugins.name: qa-embedded
plugins.description: Embedded C/C++ testing: GoogleTest on ARM, ThrowTheSwitch Unity-C and Ceedling, gcov coverage, QEMU system emulation

plugins.name: qa-game
plugins.description: Game engine testing (Unity, Unreal, Godot), platform certification overview (Sony TRC, Nintendo Lotcheck, MS XR, Steam Direct), multiplayer state machine coverage, and gameplay recording/replay

plugins.name: qa-pwa
plugins.description: Workbox recipes, offline fallback patterns, Lighthouse PWA audit interpretation, and web-push subscription lifecycle testing — distinct from qa-modern-web's generic SW/install/cache-strategy skills and qa-notifications' cross-channel push harness

plugins.name: qa-desktop
plugins.description: Desktop application testing across Windows (WinAppDriver, Appium-Windows), macOS (XCTest UI, Apple Accessibility Inspector), Linux (AT-SPI), Electron (Playwright _electron API), and Qt (QtTest framework)

plugins.name: qa-starter
plugins.description: QA essentials role bundle: one-command install of the cross-cutting plugins every tester needs regardless of stack - test process, test data, environments, test-code review, reporting, flake triage, bug repro, defect management, CI integration, and manual/exploratory testing. Start here.

plugins.name: qa-role-frontend-web
plugins.description: Frontend & web-app QA role bundle: one-command install of web E2E, visual regression, accessibility, modern web, PWA, browser-extension, localization, charts, PDF/print, browser/OS compatibility, and JS/TS unit testing.

plugins.name: qa-role-backend-api
plugins.description: Backend, API & distributed-systems QA role bundle: one-command install of API/contract/GraphQL/gRPC/real-time testing, auth flows, notifications, payment, async jobs, DB migrations, caching, concurrency, saga/CQRS, distributed tracing, serverless, time/timezones, feature flags, and experimentation.

plugins.name: qa-role-security
plugins.description: Application-security & compliance QA role bundle: one-command install of SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, SBOM, fuzzing, compliance, multi-tenancy isolation, test-data privacy, and IaC policy testing.

plugins.name: qa-role-performance-resilience
plugins.description: Performance & reliability QA role bundle: one-command install of load testing, chaos engineering, resilience drills, and shift-left / shift-right production QA.

plugins.name: qa-role-mobile-desktop
plugins.description: Mobile, desktop & cross-platform QA role bundle: one-command install of mobile-native, desktop, embedded, game, and browser/OS compatibility testing.

plugins.name: qa-role-ai-ml-data
plugins.description: AI/ML & data-pipeline QA role bundle: one-command install of LLM evaluation, ML model testing, AI-assisted test generation, search relevance, data notebooks, and data quality.

plugins.name: qa-role-leadership
plugins.description: QA leadership & test-management role bundle: one-command install of the QA role org-chart, test process, test management, impact analysis, reporting, hiring, shift-left, defect management, and production-code quality governance.

plugins.name: qa-role-manual-tester
plugins.description: Manual tester / QA analyst role bundle: one-command install of manual scripted + exploratory testing, test case management, defect management, bug reproduction, test reporting, test process, test data, and browser/OS compatibility. Organized around the job role, not a technology stack.

plugins.name: qa-role-automation-engineer
plugins.description: Test automation engineer role bundle: one-command install of web E2E, API testing, mobile automation, BDD, visual regression, CI integration, flake triage, test-code review, test data, and browser/OS compatibility. Organized around the job role, not a technology stack.

plugins.name: qa-role-sdet
